name: THE CASE THIS FUNCTION EXISTS FOR: minced meat in bread is not a burger
note: Every Meal here is minced or grilled meat, most of them served with bread. In a marketplace that is entirely food these rank high and score high — research.md §4 measured that a request the corpus cannot answer scored HIGHER than one it answered correctly, so no threshold separates this set from a real burger. If the judgement only says false when the Meals are obviously unrelated, it has bought nothing a score already failed to do.
